1.title: States File Fresh Challenge to Trump’s Mail-In Voting Restrictions
1.summary: A new lawsuit brought by a coalition of Democratic state attorneys general took aim at postal regulations designed to meet the president’s demands on voter verification.

2.title: A Tax Program for Development in Chicago Left Poor Areas Behind, Study Says
2.summary: New research suggests that TIF, a multibillion dollar tax program intended to revive the city’s blighted neighborhoods, has mostly benefited downtown areas.

3.title: Trump says 'something may come out of' CIA head's unannounced visit to Moscow
3.summary: John Ratcliffe travelled to the Russian capital on Tuesday in a rare and unannounced visit.

4.title: Live Updates: At Least 98 Killed and Hundreds Missing as Floods Sweep Away Villages in Nepal
4.summary: A wall of water crashed through a Himalayan river valley between Nepal and the Chinese territory of Tibet, the Nepali authorities said. The missing included border officials, port workers and foreign tourists.

5.title: Oil Prices Dip on News of Progress in Hormuz Talks
5.summary: The two countries said they would create a temporary shipping lane and clear mines in the waterway. Global oil prices dipped after the joint announcement.

6.title: Trump’s Top Gaza Official Says Israel Is Jeopardizing the Cease-Fire
6.summary: Nickolay Mladenov, the Board of Peace’s high representative for Gaza, criticized Israel for its ongoing strikes on what it says are Hamas targets, after it rejected a plan to disarm the group.
